description: This file implements a Python class `NvidiaTTSService` that provides a wrapper around NVIDIA Riva's cloud-based Text-to-Speech (TTS) services using gRPC API. It includes configuration, initialization, and asynchronous methods to synthesize speech from text, supporting multiple voices and languages. The file also defines input parameter models, error handling, and logging.

classes.name: NvidiaTTSService
